The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''1486 before the Battle of Yavin''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Draggulch Period]]. That year, the [[Tapani Federation]] sent its first representatives to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] is established as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Player Tapani">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>
